# Kenneth Fang

> Kenneth Johannes Fang (also Matsuo Kengo) is an independent software developer. He makes Undirect, a Safari extension for iPhone, iPad and Mac that stops pages redirecting, opening pop-under tabs or catching a tap through an invisible layer, and Cutling, a paid-once snippet keyboard for iPhone and iPad and menu bar snippet and clipboard app for Mac.

## Apps

- [Undirect](https://undirect.matsuokengo.com/): Safari redirect and pop-under blocker for iPhone, iPad and Mac; its own summary is at https://undirect.matsuokengo.com/llms.txt
- [Cutling](https://cutling.matsuokengo.com/): snippet keyboard and clipboard app for iPhone, iPad and Mac; its own summary is at https://cutling.matsuokengo.com/llms.txt
